questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Under the UHC Act (RA 11223), who is automatically included in the National Health Insurance Program?
questions.rationale: Every Filipino citizen is automatically included in the NHIP.
questions.source: RA 11223, Universal Health Care Act (2019), Sec. 5 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Every Filipino citizen shall be automatically included into the NHIP

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Under RA 11223, PhilHealth membership is grouped into:
questions.rationale: Membership is simplified into direct contributors (with capacity to pay) and indirect contributors (subsidized by government).
questions.source: RA 11223, Universal Health Care Act (2019), Sec. 8 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Membership into the Program shall be simplified into two (2) types, direct contributors and indirect contributors

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: A tricycle driver who pays his own PhilHealth premium is classified as a:
questions.rationale: Self-earning persons with capacity to pay are direct contributors.
questions.source: RA 11223, Universal Health Care Act (2019), Sec. 4(f) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: are self-earning, professional practitioners, migrant workers

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Under RA 11223, the primary care provider acts as the patient's:
questions.rationale: The primary care provider is the navigator, coordinator and initial and continuing point of contact.
questions.source: RA 11223, Universal Health Care Act (2019), Sec. 6(c) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: act as the navigator, coordinator, and initial and continuing point of contact

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Under RA 11223, what process evaluates medicines and procedures before they are funded?
questions.rationale: HTA is the systematic evaluation of health technologies to guide coverage decisions.
questions.source: RA 11223, Universal Health Care Act (2019), Sec. 4(n) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Health Technology Assessment (HTA) refers to the systematic evaluation of properties, effects, or impact of health-related technologies

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Which law now governs mandatory reporting of notifiable diseases?
questions.rationale: RA 11332 (2019) repealed Act 3573, the old Law on Reporting of Communicable Diseases.
questions.source: RA 11332, Mandatory Reporting of Notifiable Diseases Act (2019), Title (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Repealing for the Purpose Act No. 3573

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Under RA 11332, which DOH office updates the list of notifiable diseases?
questions.rationale: The DOH Epidemiology Bureau regularly updates the list with case definitions.
questions.source: RA 11332, Mandatory Reporting of Notifiable Diseases Act (2019), Sec. 5 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: The Epidemiology Bureau under the DOH shall regularly update and issue a list of nationally notifiable diseases

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: A patient with a notifiable disease refuses contact tracing. Under RA 11332 this is:
questions.rationale: Non-cooperation of persons identified as having the notifiable disease is a prohibited act.
questions.source: RA 11332, Mandatory Reporting of Notifiable Diseases Act (2019), Sec. 9(e) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Non-cooperation of the person or entities identified as having the notifiable disease

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Under RA 10121, which body serves as the disaster council in every barangay?
questions.rationale: BDCCs ceased; the Barangay Development Council serves as the LDRRMC in every barangay.
questions.source: RA 10121, Philippine DRRM Act of 2010, Sec. 11 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: existing Barangay Development Councils (BDCs) which shall serve as the LDRRMCs in every barangay

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Under RA 10121, what minimum share of regular revenue must an LGU set aside for its disaster fund?
questions.rationale: Not less than 5% of estimated regular revenue is set aside as the LDRRMF.
questions.source: RA 10121, Philippine DRRM Act of 2010, Sec. 21 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Not less than five percent (5%) of the estimated revenue from regular sources shall be set aside

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: What share of the LDRRMF is the Quick Response Fund for relief and recovery?
questions.rationale: 30% of the LDRRMF is the Quick Response (stand-by) Fund.
questions.source: RA 10121, Philippine DRRM Act of 2010, Sec. 21 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: thirty percent (30%) shall be allocated as Quick Response Fund (QRF)

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of the Community: Health System, PHC, Epidemiology & Disaster
questions.stem: Which office administers the national disaster risk reduction program under RA 10121?
questions.rationale: The OCD administers the national civil defense and DRRM program and serves as NDRRMC secretariat.
questions.source: RA 10121, Philippine DRRM Act of 2010, Sec. 8 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: The Office of Civil Defense (OCD) shall have the primary mission of administering a comprehensive national civil defense and disaster risk reduction

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Population Groups
questions.stem: Under RA 9994, a resident Filipino becomes a senior citizen at what age?
questions.rationale: A senior citizen is any resident citizen at least 60 years old.
questions.source: RA 9994, Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010, Sec. 2 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: any resident citizen of the Philippines at least sixty (60) years old

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Population Groups
questions.stem: A senior buys his maintenance drugs. Under RA 9994 he gets:
questions.rationale: Seniors get a 20% discount and VAT exemption on medicines and other covered goods and services.
questions.source: RA 9994, Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010, Sec. 4 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: the grant of twenty percent (20%) discount and exemption from the value -added tax (VAT)

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Population Groups
questions.stem: RA 8172 (ASIN law) aims mainly to eliminate:
questions.rationale: ASIN requires iodization of food-grade salt to eliminate iodine deficiency disorders.
questions.source: RA 8172, Act for Salt Iodization Nationwide (1995), Sec. 2 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: particularly iodine deficiency disorders, through the cost-effective preventive measure of salt iodization

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Individuals: Communicable & Non-Communicable Diseases
questions.stem: Under RA 10767, what must all health facilities do with TB cases?
questions.rationale: Public and private facilities follow the national TB protocol and notify the DOH of all TB cases.
questions.source: RA 10767, Comprehensive TB Elimination Plan Act (2016), Sec. 12 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall notify the DOH of all TB cases

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Individuals: Communicable & Non-Communicable Diseases
questions.stem: Which FDA policy under RA 10767 regulates anti-TB drugs?
questions.rationale: The FDA strengthens the 'No prescription, No anti-TB drugs' policy to curb misuse and resistance.
questions.source: RA 10767, Comprehensive TB Elimination Plan Act (2016), Sec. 11 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: No prescription, No anti-TB drugs

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Individuals: Communicable & Non-Communicable Diseases
questions.stem: A 16-year-old wants an HIV test without telling her parents. Under RA 11166 the nurse:
options: May get consent from her alone
questions.rationale: Persons 15 to below 18 may consent to voluntary HIV testing without parental consent.
questions.source: RA 11166, Philippine HIV and AIDS Policy Act (2018), Sec. 29(a) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: consent to voluntary HIV testing shall be obtained from the child without the need of consent from a parent or guardian

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Individuals: Communicable & Non-Communicable Diseases
questions.stem: An employer requires a negative HIV test before hiring. Under RA 11166 this is:
questions.rationale: Testing as a prerequisite for employment is compulsory HIV testing, which the law prohibits.
questions.source: RA 11166, Philippine HIV and AIDS Policy Act (2018), Sec. 3(g) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: the use of testing as a prerequisite for employment

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Individuals: Communicable & Non-Communicable Diseases
questions.stem: Before an HIV test, the nurse gives information and emotional support. This is called:
questions.rationale: Pre-test counseling gives biomedical information and emotional support before testing.
questions.source: RA 11166, Philippine HIV and AIDS Policy Act (2018), Sec. 3(hh) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: before the individual is subjected to the test
